key.name: binary
key.description: Name or full path of the rogctl binary.

key.name: interval
key.description: How often to read the mouse battery.

key.name: low-threshold
key.description: Notify and turn the indicator red at or below this level. 0 disables it.

key.name: hide-when-disconnected
key.summary: Hide when no mouse is connected
key.description: Hide the indicator while the receiver or cable is unplugged.
